description: Hand corrections to the trust's own hut and campsite records, applied by the build on top of the KMZ. Each one is keyed by the record's ArcGIS GlobalID, names the record as the trust publishes it, and says why and on what evidence. The build fails if a correction no longer matches the record it was written for. routeNames corrects misspelt section, segment and crossing names by exact match.

sites.reason: The trust publishes this address in the site's phone field. It is an email address, so it is shown as the site's email contact instead of as a phone number.
Spelling: "Accomodation" is a misspelling of "Accommodation".
The park's own name is Whanganui River Top 10 Holiday Park, and the city's official name is Whanganui (NZ Gazetteer place 7006).
Renamed: the park's own site says "Formerly Lake Tekapo Motels and Holiday Park", at the same address and phone number. The trust's website link redirects there.
Capitalisation: DOC's own page names it Bay of Many Coves campsite.
Macron: the official name is Pākiri (NZ Gazetteer place 35107), and the park spells its own name Pākiri Beach Holiday Park.
Macron: the official name of the forest is Puketī Forest (NZ Gazetteer place 54972), and DOC's own page names the hut Puketī Forest Hut.
Macron: Puketī as in the official Puketī Forest (NZ Gazetteer place 54972); DOC's own page names it Puketī Recreation Area campsite.
Macron: the hut is at the head of the Tīmaru River, Otago (official, NZ Gazetteer place 44068), and DOC's own page names it Top Tīmaru Hut. Not the Canterbury city, which is officially unmacronned.

Consistency with Pāhautea Hut, the record beside it. The NZ Gazetteer has no official name here (only an unofficial recorded Pahautea, place 58563), so this follows DOC, whose own page names the site Pāhautea Hut Campsite.

sites.note: Access: the Mangatepopo Track from here to Whakapapa Village has been closed indefinitely since the November 2025 fire (Te Araroa alert 254; DOC, 18 May 2026), and Mangatepopo Road is open only to approved shuttle operators.
sites.reason: The Mangatepopo Track has been closed since the Tongariro National Park fire of November 2025; the KMZ does not say so.

sites.note: Access: DOC says Tihoi and Bog Inn Roads are closed and the hut cannot be reached on foot or by vehicle using them, and the track between Mt Pureora and Bog Inn is no longer maintained.
sites.reason: DOC's page for the hut reports the road closures and the unmaintained track; the KMZ does not.

sites.note: DOC lists this hut as derelict: an old Quailburn Station mustering hut that may offer very basic shelter.
sites.reason: The trust added this hut by hand (DOC system ID 99999) with 6 bunks; it is not in DOC's hut data, and DOC's Quailburn Track page describes it as derelict.
The trust's link is cut off mid-path and leads to DOC's 'Page not found'. The name is right: DOC's own page is titled Boielles Campsite.

sites.note: A basic six-bunk hut owned and managed by the Mackenzie Alpine Trust; DOC says a $10 donation can be left at the hut.
sites.reason: The trust's record has no tags, so the build typed it a campsite. DOC describes it as a basic six-bunk hut.

sites.note: Private hut owned by Longslip Station, not covered by the Backcountry Hut Pass: 6 bunks, $10 a night by honesty box or internet banking (account details in the hut). The track here crosses private farmland, where DOC says there is no camping before the conservation area boundary.
sites.reason: The trust's record has no tags, so the build typed it a campsite. The trust's own Otago trail notes describe a 6-bunk private hut that walkers may use for $10 a night; DOC's track page marks it private and rules out camping on the farmland around it.
sites.source: Te Araroa Trust Otago trail notes, Breast Hill Track, last edited 27 August 2026 (https://www.teararoa.org.nz/notes-and-maps/, served from https://thetrailapp-members-api.azurewebsites.net/api/notes/region/9); https://www.doc.govt.nz/parks-and-recreation/places-to-go/otago/places/hawea-conservation-park/things-to-do/breast-hill-track/

sites.reason: The park's own site, which the trust's record links to, calls it Pinewoods Holiday Park; TOP 10 lists the same park (23 Marie Avenue, 09 426 4526) as Red Beach TOP 10 Holiday Park. Both names are current, so both are given.
The trust's website link (campervanpark.co.nz) is dead: the domain no longer resolves (checked 23 October 2026). The name is kept; listings for 263 Studholme Road disagree on the current operator.
